issue.body:
Similar to https://github.com/yiisoft/yii2/issues/3749 and https://github.com/yiisoft/yii2/commit/76800fb9e0a819131a2dd559cf60a3625c7d3718

This problem happens only if I override the Bootstrap Asset Bundle with a downloaded version from bootstrap...

```
assetManager' => [
            'bundles' => [
                'yii\bootstrap\BootstrapAsset' => [
                    'sourcePath' => null,
                    'css' => [
                        'bootstrap/css/bootstrap.min.css',
                    ],
                    'js' => [
                        'bootstrap/js/bootstrap.min.js',
                    ],
                ],
```

Then, if I create a yii\bootstrap\ButtonDropdown in my view, it does not open when clicked...
A solution is to either not override the Bootstrap Asset Bundle with the latest downloaded version or to comment out:

```
inside ButtonDropdown
at public function run()
//$this->registerPlugin('button');
```

this also happens if I have a button placed on the same view unless I also comment out on the button the same line on the Button class...

In general, the registerPlugin('button'); creates a "conflict" with the dropdown button and custom bootstrap bundles.

repository.name: yii2

issue.body:
In the run() method of all the bootstrap components, the parent's registerPlugin() is called. However, the Dropdown component is an exception; it just registers the Bootstrap plugin.

Consequently, nothing is done with the clientEvents property (nor with the clientOptions).

issue.title: ButtonDropDown Split with href not working as expected
issue.body:
### What steps will reproduce the problem?
create a button, enable split and add the href option

### What's expected?
as the button is split clicking on the button should open the "default" action referenced by href
Clicking on the arrow should display the dropdown list

### What do you get instead?
The dropdown list is displayed. 

### Additional info
What's the sense of having a split button if this is the behaviour of the 2 buttons is the same?
